 Cameron Saliga Fri, October 30, 2026 at 10:05 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Rainy weather on the way, when will it arrive? High pressure continues to dominate up to the north of the area, with cloudy skies overtaking the sky overnight. Tomorrow there will be mostly cloudy skies with highs in the upper 60s and a low chance of a stray shower in the afternoon. Sunday will be another cloudy day with a chance of some light rain in the afternoon and evening hours. Another round of showers possible on Monday with highs in the lower 70s. A dry day on Tuesday before our next round of showers on Wednesday and Thursday as a low pressure moves through the area. Highs will be in the upper 60s, but will cool to the lower 60s by Friday as a cold front moves through.
